rationale: Actual DESIGN-POSITIONS.positions[].scope text (not Gemini's substitute): one separately authorized stage in fresh T5 current-cardano-k2-k5-single-party-test-setup-20261016, steps P1 P0 Q5 K5a K5b K5M K5g H5 Z51 Z52 once in order, only after K4H closed KH3 10/10 + KH6 PASS + no relation-level finding, two agreeing positions per clause, and exact crypto authorization naming DV-K2-1-R; nothing proves/verifies/pairs/publishes a key or touches ledger/wallet/network. Implemented by P1 precondition-first mkdir, once/need chains in all steps, and k5_preconditions REVIEW_VALUES. Author FOR is one position; this fresh non-author AGREE is the distinct second substantive position for root tally, not authority itself. Reserve/allocate gets compile re-observation only, no setup. Oracle-unit fixtures give no genuine financial/ledger context (EXPECTATIONS nonClaims).

sbx_run identical in Q5/K5a/K5b/K5M excludes toolchain/cargo home/registry/target/home/host paths, ro bin+in, rw out+keys only, synthetic /dev, tmpfs /tmp, loopback-only net, stdin /dev/null. probe-k5.sh fully probes namespaces vs host, CapEff, loopback, pid isolation, absence of home/SDK/cache/host paths, mount ro/rw, empty out/keys, env and GNU time before any mori-k2 compile; Q5 failure is BLOCKED(capability) with no fallback view.

Caps match source exactly: K5a/K5b CPU/wall 600/900, Q5 120/300, host steps 300/600 or less, K5M one process RLIMIT_AS 8GiB (prlimit --as=8589934592), RLIMIT_CORE 0, nice 10, RLIMIT_CPU 3600s, wall 3600 + kill-after 60, GNU time inside view, MemAvailable >=10485760kB and disk >=6GiB gated immediately before in res_ok. One attempt, zero retries, no cap change in any step text. Setup cost is explicitly unobserved, so these are measurement bounds, not need estimates.

Classification mapping is implemented as record-then-classify: P1/P0 refusals BLOCKED(prerequisite), Q5 BLOCKED(capability), pin/binary/descriptor/root mismatches BLOCKED(identity), K5g STOP-CUSTODY/STOP-IDENTITY/FAIL-PREDICTION/no-verdict to hygiene/identity/FAILED(prediction)/environment, K5M resource deaths BLOCKED(resource), getrandom BLOCKED(abnormal-exit) with precedence (DV-K2-1-R via OsRng panic path in author-input-146), other signal/panic BLOCKED(abnormal-exit), refused:/usage: FAILED(prediction) except P0-verified I/O path BLOCKED(layout), H5 classifies nothing, Z51/Z52 BLOCKED(hygiene) after which no result qualifies. Scripts record (H5 extracts verbatim abnormal lines); the fresh actual-result reviewer classifies from full logs. No BLOCKED is ever FAILED.

Custody/retention/publication as written: operator source root-pinned before use and re-verified in Z51; T5/w retained unchanged until actual-result review closes; proving key recorded only by path/mode/size/nlink/SHA-256 behind lstat + O_NOFOLLOW guards (k5g open_listed/proving_key chunked hash; Z51 0600/nlink1 guard) and only when the custody guard permits; failed-invocation leftovers stay, are recorded the same way, never reused; no step deletes anything; publishable material is logs/journals/receipts only, never w/binaries/keys/caches/host files (Z52 freeze scope logs+receipts). Key deletion is a later separately reviewed exact custody step at review close unless that review names a retaining follow-up. DV-K2-1-R exact custody text and its two existing votes in classification-custody-second-position/audit/VOTES.md are retained unaltered; this review casts no DV-K2-1-R vote and invents none.

K5g exactly as in k5g_gate.py: regular non-link record <=1MiB, strict JSON, exact format/trustProfile/notice/driver verified against pinned lib.rs/export.rs constants, relation field-for-field equal to stage-C K4b descriptor (correct actual name, not Prep/R1CS substitutes), 488-byte VK with bytes 336..344 == 0300000000000000 and recomputed BLAKE2b-256 == vkDigestBlake2b256, stdout observedR1csSha256 == e458153e..., exactly one regular non-link 0600 key whose size/SHA-256 equal the record; key hashed in 1MiB chunks, never stored/printed/copied. Strict setup-record fields, 488-byte VK/wire flags/BLAKE2b, observed R1CS digest and stage-C descriptor equality were all read in driver export.rs/encoding.rs/relation.rs/setup.rs source.

Provenance honesty is explicit in gate output: chain predicateDigest, descriptor r1csSha256, Cargo.lock 39b7db9b..., toolchain 1.99.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, KH2 release mori-k2 SHA-256, observedR1csSha256 and VK digest recorded as declared provenance with consumerCanCheckVkToMatrixLink=false; gate claims no VK-to-matrix verification, no subgroup/pairing validation, and no financial/ledger/deployment meaning. Full PK curve/subgroup/embedded-VK/pairing remains future K6; a K5g PASS must never be quoted as certifying VK-matrix binding. Specimens are oracle-unit fixtures, so no genuine financial or ledger context is setup-covered.
